g.text: Validate inputs; copy and normalize caller attributes
Throw argument exception; no state change or event
Read monotonic elapsed and wall clock
Host Resource supplies identity; current trace context is inherited.
A batch processor may defer export; a simple processor may export here.
If emit throws an ordinary exception, the core contains it and
invokes its optional diagnostic callback. Observed state is retained.
Composite sinks independently contain failures and attempt each child.
Calls are synchronous; concurrent deliveries may arrive out of order.
Returning from the call is not a delivery acknowledgement.
